title: Check CPU requirements before a runtime upgrade
goal: Check the .NET 11 x86/x64 CPU baseline before deployment and distinguish a startup requirement from a ReadyToRun optimization target.

selectionNotes: Probe covers x86/x64 CPUID only; run a pre-upgrade tool under .NET 10 on candidate machines. Arm64 and unsupported CPU startup are not executed.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: The described runtime capability or baseline changes in .NET 11.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build net11.0 references; the exact RC2 SDK is an evidence baseline.

language.reason: Canonical sample language mode; no preview language syntax is needed.

packageAssets: Framework references and runtime assemblies; no external NuGet package.
platforms: Windows x64 executed. x86/x64 desktop/server CPU policy; Arm64 guidance is source-reviewed with an explicit Windows documentation conflict.
prerequisites: Console project with net11.0, C# 15.0, nullable and implicit usings enabled. Complete source and usage are bundled below.
constraints: Probe covers x86/x64 CPUID only; run a pre-upgrade tool under .NET 10 on candidate machines. Arm64 and unsupported CPU startup are not executed.
stabilityLimitations: Verified on RC2 artifacts; reconcile final .NET 11 GA contracts before release.

evidence.scope: Actual Windows x64 CPUID and successful runtime execution; masked required bits check rejection policy only, not execution on unsupported hardware or Arm64.
